title: A complex trust and a museum's UBTI
instructions: Answer the questions about two unrelated taxpayers for 2025.

exhibits.title: The Reyes Family Trust (complex trust)
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Taxable interest | 40,000 |
| Qualified dividends | 20,000 |
| Tax-exempt interest | 10,000 |
| Long-term capital gain (allocated to corpus) | 30,000 |
| Trustee fee (charged to corpus) | 7,000 |
| Discretionary distribution to beneficiary | 63,000 |

Of the trustee fee, **$1,000** is allocable to tax-exempt income.

exhibits.title: Harbor Museum (§501(c)(3))
exhibits.content:
| Activity | Result |
|---|---:|
| Public parking garage, open daily, paid staff: revenue | 80,000 |
| Parking garage expenses | 30,000 |
| Magazine advertising (separate business): net loss | (15,000) |
| Dividends on endowment | 40,000 |
| Sales of donated artwork prints by volunteers | 25,000 |

Gross receipts total **$2.4 million**; total assets **$30 million**.

rows.label: Taxable income before the distribution deduction and exemption
UBTI after the specific deduction
rows.explanation: Parking 50,000 − 1,000 = **49,000**; the magazine loss can't offset another business (silo rule); dividends and volunteer sales of donated goods are excluded.

rows.label: Museum's annual information return
rows.explanation: Receipts and assets exceed the 990-EZ limits.

rows.label: Who is taxed on the trust's capital gain?
rows.explanation: Gains allocated to corpus aren't in DNI.
